boot_selection_candidate.status: OTA selection candidate from captured bytes; bootloader UART load offset independently observed after reset

bootloader_observation.evidence_type: read-only UART capture after normal hard reset
bootloader_observation.observation_scope: confirms the bootloader reported loading this partition at capture time; does not establish later runtime health

limits: A tabela é encontrada ao varrer offsets alinhados a 4 KiB e validada pelo parser local ESP-IDF 5.2.6 gen_esp32part.py; nenhum offset fixo de tabela ou app é presumido.
CRC e validade de otadata seguem bootloader_common_ota_select_* do ESP-IDF 5.2.6. A sequência identifica o candidato OTA selecionado pelas cópias válidas.

A captura UART privada posterior a reset normal informa o offset carregado pelo bootloader e seu hash está registrado; isso não prova saúde posterior do processo nem exclui fallback após essa observação.
esptool image_info verifica estrutura, checksum e hash anexado quando presente; política eFuse de revisão do chip e anti-rollback não foram estabelecidos independentemente por esta leitura offline.
NVS e strings arbitrárias do firmware nunca são impressos nem copiados para o relatório sanitizado.

otadata.crc_crosscheck: zlib seed UINT32_MAX agrees with independent ROM complement/polynomial bitwise implementation on both records
otadata.selection_basis: highest valid OTA sequence; slot=(ota_seq-1) modulo OTA app count

physical_bench_plan.ota_flow: This is manual app-slot programming and exact restoration, not OTA rollout or slot selection.
physical_bench_plan.preserve: Keep bootloader, partition table, otadata, ota_1 and NVS untouched. Compare the complete post-test flash against the baseline and accept differences only inside ota_0 before restoring; after restoration require the full-flash SHA-256 to match the baseline.
physical_bench_plan.restore: After the test, restore the exact original ota_0 bytes from this private full-flash baseline and verify the restored partition SHA-256 equals the captured baseline hash.
physical_bench_plan.scope: A planned bench test uses a manually written test image at the currently active ota_0 slot; firmware OTA selection is not implemented for this run.

restore_guidance.app_only: After the planned manual test write to ota_0, exact-restore all captured 0x700000 bytes to ota_0 at 0x20000 and verify its SHA-256 matches the baseline. Sequence 1 already selects ota_0, so leave otadata unchanged.
restore_guidance.bootloader: Leave the bootloader untouched during this bench run; the map does not separately establish its exact region for restoration.
restore_guidance.device_security: Flags read for the capture report Secure Boot and Flash Encryption disabled; this offline map does not read all eFuses or prove anti-rollback is disabled.
restore_guidance.nvs: Leave NVS untouched and do not expose its contents; compare it against the captured baseline to detect unintended writes.
restore_guidance.otadata: Leave otadata untouched during this bench run; compare it against the captured baseline to detect unintended writes.
restore_guidance.partition_table: Leave the partition table untouched during this bench run; compare it against the captured baseline to detect unintended writes.
restore_guidance.principle: For this bench run, only the test app region may be written; exact-restore that region from the private baseline. The decoder performs no writes.
